name: Raamen! Raako no Bouken
original_name: らあめん！らぁ子の冒険
source:
Grandpa's ramen shop is in trouble!　Seems the only way to solve the problem is with the jawline of a 90's hottie...!

[Translated from [url=https://kumakumaf.itch.io/raako]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
爷爷的拉面店遇到麻烦了！　看来解决这个问题的唯一办法就是90后辣妹的下巴线……！
